potions.title: Healing rules
potions.order: From the top: the first matching rule whose cooldown has ended. A cooldown skips the rule and lets the next one be checked. The bot does not check your item supply.

potions.defer: Postpone Senzu on a sudden Ki loss
potions.deferNote: After a single drop from ≥90% to ≤5% Ki, the bot waits 1 s for a hit message. With stable HP it may use one Senzu. Ki that stays low, or another sudden drop within 30 s, holds further attempts for Ki. A hit or an HP drop brings back normal healing. While postponing, active HP rules come first with an emergency threshold of 75%.
potions.deferral.waiting: First Senzu for Ki postponed. The bot respects the item's cooldown.
potions.deferral.used: Senzu attempted. Further use for Ki alone is held while Ki stays low.
potions.deferral.watch: Ki recovered. Watching for another sudden drop.
potions.deferral.held: Ki dropped again. Senzu for Ki alone is held. To resume by hand, turn off the postponing and save the rules.
potions.cooldownNote: By default the rules use the shared cooldown. An own cooldown can make the break longer for a specific item. Changing the item keeps the setting; the current wait does not reset. The threshold is drawn again after each attempt within the ± range.
potions.unknownCooldown: An active rule has no cooldown set. Set it before saving working rules or turning on automation. New rules start off.
potions.measureNote: Passive observation for 5 minutes. It runs alongside the rules and tells manual attempts from automatic ones. It sends no commands and does not hold healing.
potions.measureStarted: Measuring for 5 minutes; the rules keep working.
potions.measureFooter: “Using…” may come before a refusal. Use is confirmed only by a lower count in the next reply for the same item; the last attempt may wait for the next report. Moving or trading items breaks the comparison. When attempts overlap, the result stays ambiguous. Δ HP/Ki does not confirm use or a cooldown.
